verdict.rationale: The product line includes NFC-branded models (the 'Nitrokey 3A NFC' shop listing, and a user who ordered a 'Nitrokey 3C NFC') that ship FIDO2. The docs also have an 'Android / NitroPhone' section. However, nothing in the evidence describes tapping the key on a phone over NFC to sign in through mobile browsers or apps. Missing for 10: explicit docs on NFC FIDO2 authentication on Android/iOS, mobile browser and app compatibility details, hands-on confirmation that NFC tap-to-auth works on phones.
